evidence.sql: SELECT run_id, kind, town, center_utc, params FROM runs WHERE run_id = 'bw-batu-pahat-2026100618'

SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS hours, AVG(pm25) AS mean_pm25, MAX(pm25) AS max_pm25 FROM pm25
      WHERE town = 'Batu Pahat' AND valid_utc > CAST('2026-10-05T18:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc <= CAST('2026-10-06T18:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT a.scale, SUM(a.weight) AS w_total,
            SUM(CASE WHEN f.concession_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.weight ELSE 0 END) AS w_concession,
            SUM(CASE WHEN f.on_peat THEN a.weight ELSE 0 END) AS w_peat,
            COUNT(*) AS n_fires,
            SUM(CASE WHEN f.concession_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_in_concession,
            SUM(CASE WHEN f.on_peat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_peat
       FROM attribution a JOIN fires f ON a.fire_id = f.fire_id
      WHERE a.run_id = 'bw-batu-pahat-2026100618' GROUP BY a.scale ORDER BY a.scale

SELECT COALESCE(c.group_name, c.company, c.concession_id) AS holder, a.scale, SUM(a.weight) AS w, COUNT(*) AS n_fires
       FROM attribution a JOIN fires f ON a.fire_id = f.fire_id
       JOIN concessions c ON f.concession_id = c.concession_id
      WHERE a.run_id = 'bw-batu-pahat-2026100618' GROUP BY COALESCE(c.group_name, c.company, c.concession_id), a.scale

SELECT COALESCE(co.parent_country, 'not recorded') AS parent_country, a.scale, SUM(a.weight) AS w, COUNT(*) AS n_fires
       FROM attribution a JOIN fires f ON a.fire_id = f.fire_id
       JOIN concessions c ON f.concession_id = c.concession_id
       LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.group_name = c.group_name
      WHERE a.run_id = 'bw-batu-pahat-2026100618' GROUP BY COALESCE(co.parent_country, 'not recorded'), a.scale

SELECT c.concession_id, c.name, c.company, c.group_name, c.map_source, c.map_date,
            COUNT(*) AS n_fires, SUM(CASE WHEN f.on_peat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS peat_fires, SUM(a.weight) AS w,
            MIN(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM f.acq_utc) AS BIGINT)) AS first_seen_epoch, MAX(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM f.acq_utc) AS BIGINT)) AS last_seen_epoch
       FROM attribution a JOIN fires f ON a.fire_id = f.fire_id
       JOIN concessions c ON f.concession_id = c.concession_id
      WHERE a.run_id = 'bw-batu-pahat-2026100618' AND a.scale = 1
      GROUP BY c.concession_id, c.name, c.company, c.group_name, c.map_source, c.map_date
      ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 8

limitations: Fire detections inside a concession show where land burned, not who lit it; names are leads for verification.
Concession boundaries come from public compilations and may be outdated.
